transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because... well, nothing feels like mine anymore. I used to get excited about things, you know? Looking at murals around the city, going for runs, playing basketball. Even just making a good drink at work used to feel good. Now I just stand there behind the bar, and... I don't care about any of it. It's just gone.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been about two months. Yeah, right around two months ago. That's when the bar got bought out, and... well, everything I had been working toward just got changed. It's been like this ever since then.
Along with losing interest in things, have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless most days?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean, it's not like I'm crying all the time or anything, but... I just feel empty. Every day is just sort of flat. I wake up and I just feel heavy, like there's no point to anything. So, yeah, I guess I do feel down pretty much every day.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before in your life, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

No, this is... this is the first time. I've had bad days before, sure, like anyone else. But nothing like this. It's never dragged on for months, and it's never felt this... heavy. So, yeah, this is new for me.
How has your sleep been over these past two months?

It hasn't been great. I mean, I'll go to bed feeling really tired, but... my mind just won't shut off. I just lie there, and my head keeps going over every little mistake I made at work, just playing it on a loop. And then, when I finally do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up really early, like around four or five in the morning. Once I'm up, that's it. I can't get back to sleep at all.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight over these past two months?

Yeah, my appetite is pretty much gone. Most days I honestly just forget to eat until my hands start shaking while I'm working behind the bar. Then I might grab a few bites of something cold after closing, but... even just looking at food makes me feel kind of sick. So I've definitely lost some weight, though I haven't really checked the scale.
With everything feeling so heavy lately, have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?

No, I haven't... I haven't thought about hurting myself. It's more just... I feel really empty and tired all the time. But I don't want to end it or anything. I just want this heavy feeling to stop, you know? But no, no thoughts of actually harming myself.
Have you ever had periods where you felt the exact opposite—having unusually high energy, needing much less sleep than usual, or feeling like your thoughts were racing?

No, I can't say I have. I've never really had a time where I felt super energized or didn't need to sleep. It's never been like that for me. It's mostly just... feeling completely drained all the time. So, no, no racing thoughts or high energy like you're talking about.
